canonical_hash_scheme: sha256 over this object with all keys prefixed '_' recursively removed; json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).
claim_ceiling: Phase A smoke-only wiring proof for the single retrieval-family rung3 powered learner path on this offline TLGP lab. It is not evidence for H0, H1, mechanism validity, agency, self, subjectivity, AGI, EGO readiness, companion readiness, or any production/runtime effect.

candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: training path and metric emission through existing runner-style code
candidates.expected_failure_mode: the banked verdict.py two-primary-family H1 clause cannot express a single validated retrieval family without silent reinterpretation
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: high claim-scope risk because the prereg primary families are pooling instruments and the H1 branch requires both primaries
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: self-test fixture with one eligible retrieval family cannot reach a scoped H1 branch without modifying verdict.py
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: context-free or graph-cache baseline could still explain smoke-level behavior

candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: lower-reference and graph-cache scores on rung1/rung3 smoke episodes
candidates.expected_failure_mode: does not prove retrieval_model training, evaluation, ablation, or adjudicator wiring runs end-to-end
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: low model-leakage risk, but high under-testing risk for the powered learner path
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: a tiny training smoke fails even though baselines compute
candidates.strongest_cheap_baseline_that_could_matc: successor_map graph-cache with fixed default under equal adapt access

candidates.evidence_it_would_produce: frozen design, new single-family adjudicator self-test across all terminals, rung1 and rung3 tiny training, ideal/meta/fair/headroom metrics, leakage positive control, context-ablation smoke, split assertions, and protected-source guards
candidates.expected_failure_mode: protected hash/status drift, capacity/prereg mismatch, full-budget launch, planted leak not caught, split assertion failure, or adjudicator terminal coverage failure
candidates.leakage_or_hardcoding_risk: managed by read-only imports, source hashes, no rule_id/query_e model inputs, planted leakage controls, and smoke-only claim ceiling
candidates.smallest_falsifying_test: 1-seed 4-episode smoke cannot run both normal and ablated paths or adjudicator self-test misses a terminal

collision_record.selection_reason: It is the smallest option that tests the requested implementation wiring while keeping the family substitution explicit, preserving banked files read-only, and avoiding any full 10-seed evidence run.

context_ablation.collapse_definition_for_smoke: normal_meta_minus_ablated_meta is recorded against fair_max for shuffle-adapt and no-adapt; smoke records numbers only and does not adjudicate scientific pass/fail.

rung1_scanner.purpose: cheap-baseline saturation readback for seen-rule capability path

decision_statistic.H0_single_family: headroom_vs_meta <= DELTA on at least close_fraction_min seeds
decision_statistic.H1_single_family: LCB(headroom_vs_meta) > DELTA for the single eligible retrieval family
decision_statistic.inconclusive: CI straddles DELTA, eligibility/discriminativeness/integrity is not clean, or seed count is below MODEL_SEEDS for formal evidence
decision_statistic.scope: single validated retrieval_model family only; not the prereg two-primary-family H1 clause

family_substitution.deviation_text: The prereg primary pooling families are not used as primaries for this Phase A path. The validated retrieval_model is substituted as the single scoped primary family because the pooling primaries are confounded for in-context retrieval.
family_substitution.scope_limit: Only the retrieval family is adjudicated; two-family prereg H1 is not claimed.

training_budget.only_permitted_cross_rung_difference: DATA (which rules / which values / seen vs unseen) -- never compute/architecture/budget

rung1_eligibility.formal_rule: meta_balacc >= ideal_seen1 - DELTA on at least close_fraction_min MODEL_SEEDS
rung1_eligibility.phase_a_smoke: compute ideal/meta/fair/headroom and scanner only; do not claim eligibility from smoke

rung3_single_family.formal_H1: LCB(headroom_vs_meta) > DELTA after retrieval eligibility and discriminativeness
rung3_single_family.phase_a_smoke: adjudicator emits a verdict over tiny recorded fields, marked non-evidential

stop_conditions: family substitution not frozen or not declared
DELTA, MODEL_SEEDS, close_fraction_min, or training budget differ from prereg
any banked or frozen source edit appears
full 10-seed budget launches during Phase A
planted leakage control is not caught
context-ablation path does not execute for rung1 and rung3
adjudicator self-test does not reach all terminals
